rules.title: the frontend must not import backend or server implementation code
rules.suggestion: call the API instead of importing server code

rules.title: the backend must not import frontend or edge-function code
rules.suggestion: share data through the API contract, not by importing across applications

rules.title: edge functions must not import frontend or backend code (separate deployables)
rules.suggestion: duplicate nothing: share through the database or an API contract

rules.title: UI components must not use the database client directly; go through api.js or a data hook
rules.suggestion: move the query into api.js (or a use*.js hook) and call that from the component

rules.title: only supabaseClient.js may import the Supabase SDK in the frontend
rules.suggestion: import the shared client from supabaseClient.js

rules.title: route files must not reach the database; routes call controllers, controllers call services
rules.suggestion: move the query into a controller/service

rules.title: lower backend layers must not import routes or controllers (wrong dependency direction)
rules.suggestion: invert the dependency: pass the data in, or move shared code down into a service/util

rules.title: controllers must not import routes
rules.suggestion: routes depend on controllers, never the other way round

rules.title: shared utilities (lib/) must not depend on components, pages or app state
rules.suggestion: keep lib/ free of UI and application imports; pass values in as arguments

rules.title: the marketing site (landing/) must not import application components or pages
rules.suggestion: put shared pieces in lib/ or landing/components

rules.title: data hooks and API modules must not depend on UI components
rules.suggestion: business/data logic must not import UI; invert the dependency
